title: SWF compiler: emit PlaceObject3 for text and bitmap display objects with filters
description: compile.ts lines 1407-1441 always emit PlaceObject2 for TextDisplayObject and BitmapDisplayObject even when they have enabled filters. Fix: check hasEnabledFilters on these types and emit PlaceObject3 instead (same as SymbolInstance). Also need a variant of encodePlaceObject3WithFilters that supports the HasName flag for named text fields.
